title: athyrium filix-femina subsp. pectinatum
intro: Athyrium filix-femina subsp. pectinatum, commonly known as lady fern, is a type of flowering plant in the fern family (Athyriaceae) that belongs to the species of Athyrium. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that help to protect against various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium filix-femina subsp. pectinatum include wound healing, antispasmodic, and antiulcerative activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant may contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic uses, although further research is needed to confirm its effects on human health.
